products.note: Multi-agent framework; agent collaboration; task delegation; emerging governance patterns

profile_text.body:
CrewAI is a company that provides a multi-agent AI framework designed to enable agent collaboration and task delegation across business workflows. Its platform, also called CrewAI, includes a feature called CrewAI Discovery, which the company describes as matching patterns observed over billions of agent runs against a customer's tickets, chats, apps, and workflows to produce a ranked list of automation opportunities by effort, value, and readiness. The company's site presents case examples in which organizations have deployed its AI agents for tasks including lead enrichment, curriculum design, lead data consolidation, and customer support ticket handling, with named customers including Gelato, General Assembly, Docusign, and Piracanjuba.

The held facts classify CrewAI's product under Coding and Developer Tools, noting its use in multi-agent frameworks, agent collaboration, task delegation, and emerging governance patterns. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the available data.
